JOB TITLE Frontend Developer/Engineer (React/Next.js & Native Mobile)-Male or Female-JOB CODE-N/07/11/26-Kakkanad GENDER Male or Female EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Web Stacks: 3+ years of professional experience with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Context API).
  • Mobile Stacks: Proven experience building native apps with Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android). Dual-platform proficiency or a willingness to lead both native tracks is highly valued.
  • Data & Analytics UI: Experience working with data visualization libraries like D3.js, Chart.js, or Recharts.
  • Tooling: Mastery of Git, modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite), and responsive design principles (Tailwind CSS or Styled Components).
  • Portfolio: A portfolio of live web applications or published apps on the Apple App Store / Google Play Store.

SALARY Negotiable QUALIFICATION IT Degree
